newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia reopens May/June coffee registrations.
newsitem.headline: Colombia reopens May/June coffee registrations.

text.p: Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation has decided to reopen May/June coffee registrations for shipments by private exporters to Europe and Japan, more than one month after shutting them down, industry sources said Friday.

A statement from the National Coffee Exporters' Association of Colombia (Asoexport) said registrations for the shipment of up to 500,000 60-kg bags of coffee to Europe and Japan in May and June, would be opened to private exporters next week.

The federation's general manager, Jorge Cardenas, said earlier this week that the federation was having "enormous difficulties" meeting its export commitments because of an unusually tight supply of coffee on the domestic market.
Federation officials could not be reached for immediate comment. But the statement from Asoexport appeared to indicate that the federation's shortfall for May and June totalled a full 500,000 bags.
Registrations for shipments by private exporters in April, May and June were originally opened by the federation on March 7 and industry sources said they were shut down suddenly on April 14.
